definitions.major_failure: A solid human trial that found no benefit, or a trial stopped for futility, lack of effect, safety or its results. Trials stopped for funding or slow recruitment don't count.
definitions.outcomes: Positive, negative, mixed and unclear are what each treatment study's own conclusion says. Unclear includes studies that only reported safety.
definitions.solid_trial: A trial in people that was randomized and controlled (placebo, sham or comparison treatment), past the first safety stage, and not a pilot, open-label or single-group study.

meanings.A: At least one solid human trial showed benefit, with no major failures.
meanings.B: Promising human results from small or early studies, supported by animal or lab work.
meanings.C: Promising results in animals or cells only, or mixed results in people.
meanings.D: Little evidence so far, or human trials that failed or were stopped.
meanings.n/a: Not graded: biomarkers are tests, not treatments.

mechanisms.description: Misfolded α-synuclein forms glial cytoplasmic inclusions (GCIs) in oligodendrocytes and spreads cell-to-cell in a prion-like way. Small molecules aim to block aggregation.
mechanisms.name: α-Synuclein aggregation & spread
mechanisms.reason: Human results so far are negative: 2 human studies found no benefit (2 solid trials).

mechanisms.description: Failure to clear misfolded proteins via autophagy, the lysosome (incl. GBA) or the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
mechanisms.name: Autophagy, lysosome & proteostasis
mechanisms.reason: Human results so far are negative: 1 human study found no benefit (a solid trial); 2 trials were stopped for futility, safety or poor results.

mechanisms.description: Tools that make trials possible: α-synuclein seed amplification assays, neurofilament light, skin biopsy, imaging. Not a disease mechanism itself.
mechanisms.name: Biomarkers & early diagnosis
mechanisms.reason: Biomarker studies measure the disease; they don't test treatments.
